stem: Two possible causes fit a leaf symptom: insufficient nutrient supply or reduced uptake caused by root-zone conditions. Which evidence would best help distinguish them?
choices: Review nutrient inputs together with root-zone pH, EC, and symptom progression
Choose the nutrient listed first on a symptom chart
Increase all nutrients before collecting measurements
Ignore root-zone measurements because leaves provide enough evidence
rationale: Distinguishing supply from availability requires contextual evidence. Nutrient inputs, root-zone pH and EC, and how symptoms progress are more informative than a symptom image alone.
